answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The velvet counter is kept in delta and willow shows each reset. An adversary as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 13 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
